messages:

Subject: Renewal + expected usage uplift and co-term discussion

Hi Jasmine,

Quick note to flag that Carely's usage is trending up ahead of our renewal on 2026-06-30. We expect roughly a 35% uplift in inference tokens over the next 12 months as we roll out a new summarization feature to customers.

We'd like to discuss: 1) co-terming the Redwood subscription with our analytics contract, 2) flexibility on uplift pricing for the first 90 days, and 3) a short SOW amendment for dedicated capacity. I attached our current SOW for reference (Carely_SOW_v2.pdf).

Could you send a preliminary uplift quote and confirm timelines for a formal amendment + DocuSign? Procurement is looped in.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Head of Platform, Carely

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and for the SOW.

Short answer: we can support a co-term and provide a structured uplift path that softens short-term unit economics while preserving predictable committed pricing. To get you a formal amendment and quote I need two quick datapoints from your side: (a) expected monthly token profile for next 3 months (or an estimate of % of traffic that will be new), and (b) whether the dedicated capacity is a hard requirement or an option that can be staged.

I propose a 30-minute sync tomorrow or Thursday to walk through. If that works I'll loop legal/finance and produce a draft amendment + a spreadsheet quote for review (we'll include a DocuSign-ready amendment).

Proposed times: 2026-04-21 10:00 AM PT or 2026-04-22 2:00 PM PT. Which works for you?

Best,

Quick recommendation ahead of the sync with Carely:
- Offer a time-limited uplift concession: 20% off incremental token price for the first 90 days post-amendment.
- If they convert uplift to a 12-mo reserved capacity commitment (co-term with analytics), trade that for a blended 12% effective discount on the annualized committed units.
- Include a staging option: 50% of the dedicated pool at amendment signing, remainder after 60 days once usage normalizes.

I've attached a draft quote that models the two paths (short-term concession vs reserved commit). Use the second tab for DocuSign-ready amendment language (we keep legal placeholders minimal).

(Attachment: Redwood_Uplift_Quote_2026.xlsx)

Rishi

Subject: Carely — draft uplift quote and amendment (next steps)

Hi Elena — thanks for meeting earlier this week. Per our conversation I've attached the draft uplift quote and a one-page amendment summary. Key points below:

- 90-day ramp concession: 20% off incremental token price for the first 90 days after amendment effective date.
- Reserved conversion: if Carely elects to convert uplift to a 12-month reserved capacity within 90 days, we will retroactively apply a blended 12% discount across the annualized committed units.
- Staged dedicated pool: 50% provisioned at signing, remainder provisioned within 60 days.
- Co-term: Amendment will co-term Redwood services to 2027-06-30 aligning with your analytics contract; DocuSign envelope included for signature.

Attachments included: Redwood_Uplift_Quote_2026.xlsx, Carely_SOW_v2.pdf

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/Envelope/Contract-CARELY-2026

Next steps we need from you: 1) confirm which path you prefer (ramp concession vs reserved conversion), 2) procurement contact to issue PO or accept the DocuSign envelope, and 3) a target effective date (we recommend 2026-05-15 to cover the ramp window).

Happy to jump on a short call if you want to walk through the spreadsheet.

Best regards,
